key_insight: Checking symbolic reasoning steps as they are generated lets LLMs correct errors before they propagate, without restarting or calling a verifier model.
engineering_relevance: CPU-based deterministic checks can improve reliability in checkable mathematical workflows without consuming additional verifier GPU capacity.
method: Validate explicit symbolic expressions online with a computer algebra system.
Flag failed checks immediately and let the LLM continue from the error location.
Use code-based verification rather than a separate verifier LLM.
evidence_signal: On ASyMoB with three open-weights models, accuracy improved by 1.4–5.6 percentage points, with a 1.8–14.9% net reduction in incorrect answers and 6–7% more tokens.
watch_item: Results are demonstrated for symbolic mathematics; broader applicability depends on which reasoning steps deterministic checkers can validate.
paper_title: Catch It Where It Happens: Real Time Error Correction During LLM Reasoning
